user_goal: Keep every Plotkeeper-injected Codex resume bound to the enrolled run repository and fail closed when that directory is invalid.

authority.verbatim_text:
Plotkeeper’s injected resume changed MoonMarket task 019dc5bc-9c57-7aa0-a007-18250d608ad3 from Z:\MoonMarket to Z:\Plotkeeper. The cause is PlotkeeperService._run_codex() launching codex.exe exec resume without an explicit subprocess working directory.  
Fix every injected resume path—including inject_review, inject_check_in, and future equivalents—to launch with cwd=run.cwd. Fail closed if the enrolled run directory is missing or invalid; never fall back to Plotkeeper’s own process directory. The resume CLI has no --cd option, so this must be enforced through subprocess.run(..., cwd=run.cwd).  
Add a regression test that enrolls a run rooted in another repository, injects a review while Plotkeeper itself runs from Z:\Plotkeeper, and proves the resumed task’s cwd, workspace root, and project association remain bound to the enrolled repository.

semantic_changes: Route every Plotkeeper-owned Codex resume subprocess through one run-aware launcher that supplies cwd equal to the validated enrolled run directory.
Reject missing, relative, nonexistent, or non-directory run cwd before changing run state or launching Codex.
Prove cross-repository review and check-in injection retain cwd, workspace root, and project association.
Publish and install a matching patch release if independent review passes.
No run enrollment, successor, closeout-validation, task/report, UI, SpecSwarm, timing, hook, guard, or ledger-data behavior changes.
No fallback to process cwd, Plotkeeper repository cwd, caller cwd, project-name inference, or an unrelated run.
No mutation of MoonMarket or any enrolled project repository as part of injection proof.
No secret, session transcript, runtime database, or personal data commit.

invariants: Review and check-in injection preserve their existing command, session ID, prompts, state transitions, and error rollback except for explicit cwd validation.
A valid absolute run cwd is passed exactly as subprocess cwd after canonical resolution.
An invalid run cwd launches no process and does not mark review pending or add a successful check-in report.
All existing linked-successor and atomic closeout behavior remains green.
MoonMarket run records and repository contents remain read-only during verification.
